'''Mygeeto''' was a wealthy [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] colony between [[Ord Biniir/Legends|Ord Biniir]] and [[Morishim]] under the control of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Geographic features==
[[File:Mygeeto_surface.jpg|thumb|left|The jagged crystalline surface of Mygeeto.]]
Since Mygeeto was locked in an ice age, giant crystallized glaciation and ice covered its surface, as well as huge crystal spurs. Because of this, Mygeeto meant "gem" in the ancient trade language of the [[Muun/Legends|Muuns]]. Mygeeto's internal fires had long since cooled and had left a colossal deposit of precious stones within its crust and mantle. The immense assets of [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]] and fields of [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lasing crystals]] made Mygeeto one of the wealthiest worlds in the galaxy. It hosted [[Artesian (crystal)/Legends|artesian crystals]] and [[Adegan crystal/Legends|relacite]].<ref name="TEA" /> The planet's ice shelves were home to a species of huge and aggressive worm-like [[Whiteworm/Legends|creatures]]. In addition, the planet itself was enveloped by an [[Zuborte Ma|asteroid field]].<ref name="Imperial Ace" />

Mygeeto was not composed of a uniform terrain; instead it was composed of many different kinds of terrain. There was no reported volcanic activity on the planet, meaning that the planet's interior was stable. The immense amount of precious metals found in the crust supports the theory that Mygeeto's volcanic activities had been dormant for some time.

Few cities existed on Mygeeto's sunken surface. These cities drew power from synthesized crystals which were constructed in large capacitor towers that stored and distributed the valuable energy drawn from the crystal. These cities were used mainly for administering the surrounding crystal mines, though they also contained vaults which were used by the InterGalactic Banking Clan.

Nearly all of the planet's surface was covered in thick ice, and the polar climate caused massive snow storms that battered the frigid surface almost continuously. Before the giant ice age, Mygeeto had a climate ranging form polar to temperate&mdash;30% of Mygeeto was covered in polar ice caps and 70 was either tundra or temperate.
Temperature varied between -47 degrees in polar areas to 17 degrees in equatorial areas.

Every 200 years or so, Mygeeto would go through a snow shift meaning snowfall would be persistent and low pressure would dominate the northern hemisphere. This would also mean Mygeeto's mean temperature would dip, significantly affecting the whole planet.

==History==
[[File:Mygeetan.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A [[Lurmen/Legends|Lurmen]].]]

===Pre-Republic===
The sentient lemur-like [[Lurmen/Legends|Lurmens]] were indigenous to Mygeeto in times long forgotten during the [[Pre-Republic era]]. Around [[30,000 BBY]], an [[Alien/Legends|alien]] species known as the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] annexed Mygeeto as part of their [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Lurmen were forced by the Rakata to shape Mygeeto's crystal formations,<ref name="Caugh">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Caught in Crystal}}</ref> but with the break-up of their empire after five thousand years of galactic dominance the Rakata abandoned Mygeeto and retreated to their homeworld of [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]].<ref name="TEA" />

===Dark Age===
In [[6740 BBY]], the planet was rediscovered by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], with [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and then [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]] taking control of the planet in the following years.<ref name="TEA" />

===InterGalactic Banking Clan===
When the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]]-controlled [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] discovered Mygeeto, the native Lurmens were reduced to a status little better than slaves.

Due to easily mined formations of naturally-occurring, high-quality crystals and jagged rocks present on the planet, the InterGalactic Banking Clan guarded Mygeeto with a fleet of warships including [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]]. As a result, access by rivals to the planet was difficult. Even if intruders had bypassed the blockade, they were faced with the harsh, frozen surface of the planet itself.

The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had always wanted to explore the planet because of the large supply of natural crystals suitable for lightsaber construction, but the Banking Clan would not allow it.

[[File:MygeetoFromSpace.jpg|thumb|250px|Mygeeto from space]]
The Banking Clan also constructed several cities on Mygeeto. These cities were used for administering the surrounding crystal mines, though they also contained vaults which were used by the Banking Clan to store its treasures. Mygeeto had even become the sister world of the Muuns' own homeworld, [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] and like Muunilinst, Mygeeto was an economic [[Coruscant of the Outer Rim|rival]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] itself.

During the Banking Clan's rule of Mygeeto, the planet was administered by [[Caar Damask]]. The [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] Darth Tenebrous, under the guise of starship designer [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Rugess Nome]], brought Caar and a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Darth Plagueis's mother|female Muun]] together. Their son [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] was born on Mygeeto and would go on to become the Sith lord Darth Plagueis, who would later return to the planet with his apprentice [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] at the beginning of his training. Caar owned a [[Damask residence|residence]] here on Mygeeto which is where Plagueis grew up.

===Clone Wars===
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Mygeeto became a valuable member of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and was as a result named by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine as part of a "[[Triad of Evil/Legends|Triad of Evil]]," alongside [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] and [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]].

Later, [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] led the Republic assault on the world along with Commander [[Bacara/Legends|Bacara]] and the elite [[Galactic Marines/Legends|Galactic Marines]]. The planet would be the site of many horrific [[Battle of Mygeeto|battles]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], beginning in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. By the conclusion of the battle in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the vast cityscape lay in burning, ash-filled ruins. The hot ashes mixed with Mygeeto's ice crystals to cover the battlegrounds in sleet and snow. Many Republic vehicles, including [[Unstable Terrain Artillery Transport/Legends|UT-ATs]], were blown apart by Confederate [[Octuptarra magna tri-droid/Legends|tri-droids]]. Later, Ki-Adi-Mundi's forces were reinforced by troopers from the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] sent by Palpatine himself.

[[File:Mygeetobridgebattle.png|thumb|left|250px|The [[Battle of Mygeeto]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]]]
Officially, the 501st Legion had been sent to destroy a droid energy collector, but in reality they were searching for an experimental power source that Palpatine required for a top-secret [[Superlaser/Legends|tributary laser]]-stream project code-named [[Hammertong/Legends|Hammertong]] to power the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. Clone Troopers destroyed two turbo laser turrets so that Ki-Adi-Mundi could land. After landing, Ki-Adi-Mundi led an assault on the energy collector, securing the [[Energy crystal|power source]] that Palpatine had been looking for. Finally, he sent the power source offplanet to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and aided the Republic troops in battle. Towards the end of the conflict, Commander Bacara received [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and killed the Jedi General. Following the assassination, the remaining pockets of droids were eliminated, thus ending the two year-long battle and the Confederacy's presence on Mygeeto.

===Galactic Empire===
After Mundi's death and the resolution of the Clone Wars, the newly established [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] enslaved the planet, claiming it on behalf of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], who had now taken on the title of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. The Imperial war-machine would keep strict control in the turbulent times following the Clone Wars; they extensively strip-mined the planet for a mineral known as [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]], used in the construction of starship hulls. However, unlike other factions of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]], the Empire did not destroy the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|IGBC]], which would have doomed the galaxy to a crippling recession, but rather subjugated the government.<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref> Brutal labor conditions led to mass deaths among the enslaved Muun population.<ref name=":0">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>

===Galactic Civil War and after===
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Rebel Alliance exploited the unrest to incite a large-scale uprising, temporarily liberating the planet. Mygeeto fell into the hands of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. In response, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] led a contingent of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] to the planet to [[Battle of Mygeeto (Galactic Civil War)|put down]] the [[Mygeeto uprising|uprising]].<ref name="Imperial Ace" /> Though the Empire reestablished control and maintained a heavy presence, the uprising inspired ongoing resistance, with escaped slaves continuing to raid Imperial sites and liberate their kin.<ref name=":0" /> After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Mygeeto had become a member of the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] and subsequently the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. However sometime later during the war, Mygeeto was conquered by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].

By [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], however, Mygeeto lay within the New Republic's boundaries. It was subsequently [[Battle of Mygeeto (Yuuzhan Vong War)|attacked]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|war]] with the New Republic, but was not devastated like Muunilinst.

When the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] broke out in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], Mygeeto had remained an Imperial Remnant world, and had become a financial center of that entity.<ref name="Revelation" /> This trend continued with the [[Fel Empire]] and the [[Empire-in-exile]] but ended with the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]].

==Behind the scenes==
Mygeeto was created for {{Film|III}} as one of the planets in a "Clone Wars montage" that was to start the film in early drafts.<ref name="db" /> The planet was first mentioned in ''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]'',<ref name="Labryinth">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> and retroactively made its first appearance in ''[[Star Wars Journal: Darth Maul]]'', when the novel ''[[The Wrath of Darth Maul]]'' identified the icy world from that book as Mygeeto.<ref name="Wrath">''[[The Wrath of Darth Maul]]''</ref>
